# REPLACE_ME

> LLM-oriented project map for coding agents. Repo checkout convention (see https://llmstxt.org/). Prefer structured indexes under docs/llm/ over crawling the whole tree.

## Always load

- [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md): Claude Code session ops
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): cross-tool agent guidance (https://agents.md/)
- [docs/llm/INDEX.md](docs/llm/INDEX.md): curated docs map

## Structured knowledge (Diátaxis reference)

- [docs/llm/TAXONOMY.yaml](docs/llm/TAXONOMY.yaml): classifier (diataxis × load)
- [docs/llm/MODULE_MAP.yaml](docs/llm/MODULE_MAP.yaml): modules and public contracts
- [docs/llm/API_SURFACE.yaml](docs/llm/API_SURFACE.yaml): all public APIs / CLIs / exports
- [docs/llm/TEST_INDEX.yaml](docs/llm/TEST_INDEX.yaml): command → what it proves
- [docs/llm/FLOWS.md](docs/llm/FLOWS.md): critical runtime flows
- [docs/ARCHITECTURE.md](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): boundaries and invariants

## Ops (Diátaxis how-to)

- [docs/llm/TEST_INDEX.yaml](docs/llm/TEST_INDEX.yaml) · [docs/TESTING.md](docs/TESTING.md)
- [docs/RUNBOOK.md](docs/RUNBOOK.md): start / smoke / rollback (if present)
